summary: Full regression verification after repo restore + countryCode→territoryCode fix. All 13 backend tests pass. All key frontend screens verified. No regressions found.

integration_issues.issue: Shopify catalog has no products matching 'snack' (singular) but 'snacks' returns 15. This is a catalog data issue, not a code bug. UI correctly shows 'No results'.

critical_code_review_comments: schemas.py: AddressIn uses territoryCode (required) and AddressOut uses territoryCode (optional) — countryCode is fully absent. Correct.
auth/router.py: /api/auth/me, /api/auth/addresses all use get_current_user_required dependency — returns 401 for unauthenticated. Correct.
auth/router.py: POST /api/auth/logout is best-effort and returns {ok:True} even for invalid tokens. Correct.
Profile screen web path: clicking Log In shows 'Sign-in is available in the Now Kart mobile app' banner inline — web-unsupported path works correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full regression passed. territoryCode fix verified. All guest flows work. Next: implement checkout completion feature.
